note: The line optimiser's Pan Am A350-900 sample (the Scheduling chat's hand-built line of 27 Oct: SFO–LGW, LGW–SEA, SEA–PKX, LGW–LAX, SFO–PVG and PVG–LAX, 12 legs) on the 12 Oct test sample's legs at those six airports (report_2026-10-12, the 140 legs arriving at or leaving SFO, LGW, SEA, PKX, LAX and PVG, with the airports, aircraft, routes and bases they use, as rules_input() would give them; the A350-900 as the 19 Oct migration gives it, with its 14,200 km reach, and the four shared service profiles), with maintenance_max_gap_h 40, line_min_km and line_aircraft laid over cases/_base.json's settings. The search is capped by work (1,200: chains started plus lines evaluated), not seconds, so the answer is the same on every machine; that much of the fixed order reaches 17.7 h a day, maintenance 180%, a counting stop at most every 25 hours and 95 of 129 connections within 4 hours (the hand-built sample: 17.7 h, 193%, 39.6 h). Its answer is saved here; tests/line_saved_answer_test.py runs the built command on the same input and must find it. Then its 7 cards through the line check and one card alone, and a route beyond reach refused. Game data, so it lives with the dated samples (decision #9).

cases.name: the Pan Am A350-900 sample line of 27 Oct: six routes, 12 legs, on the 12 Oct sample's legs at the six airports, a work budget of 1,200
cases.rule: spec docs/specs/2026-10-27-long-haul-lines.md §1: scored by connections within plan_connection_target_h at the hubs, then all connections, then routes covered, block hours and maintenance; feasible on turns, night bans, the same-route gap, reach, maintenance at or above 100%, no stretch over maintenance_max_gap_h, closing after 168 hours, each route both ways

cases.name: the same line's 7 cards through the line check: complete, every flight daily, each route both ways every day, each card fine
cases.rule: spec §3: across the line every leg operates daily once all 7 cards exist; the same flight number on different days of different cards is not a clash; each route flown both ways every day

cases.name: the first 3 cards only: not complete, each flight on 3 weekdays with 4 missing, nothing flagged
cases.rule: spec §3: which days are missing until all 7 cards exist; with fewer cards a missing day is reported, not a problem

cases.name: one card of the line on its own: a plain card check, 12 legs on 7 different days, maintenance 180% with a counting stop at most every 25 hours
cases.rule: spec §3: each card as today, plus the maintenance spacing; a line's card is 7 different days, one repeating week

cases.name: a route beyond the type's reach is refused with the reason
cases.rule: spec §1: every route within the type's reach (aircraft_types.range_km); asking first is the Scheduling chat's job

answer.error: SFO–PVG is 9,877 km, beyond the A350-900's reach of 9,000 km
